subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should this Control UI work be scoped to channel-separated filtering first, a full separated-plus-merged timeline, or folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: Source shows channel metadata exists but no view-mode/protocol contract; the remaining choice affects UX, privacy, session-state semantics, and whether this stays separate from the broader sessions workspace issue.

options.title: Stage Channel-Separated View First
options.body: Add channel tabs/filtering over existing session rows first and defer true merged transcript aggregation until privacy and routing semantics are defined.

options.title: Build Full Toggle
options.body: Accept the larger Gateway/protocol and UI design needed for both separated channel tabs and a merged all-channel timeline.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the channel-specific requirements into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 and close this only after maintainers confirm that broader issue is canonical.

recommendation.title: Stage Channel-Separated View First
recommendation.body: Add channel tabs/filtering over existing session rows first and defer true merged transcript aggregation until privacy and routing semantics are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this handle to session protocol, sidebar/session UX, and product-sensitive Control UI session behavior.
